Omnia AL400 Aluminum Cabinet Hardware

Light weight, durable, and easy to clean, this aluminum cabinet pull is made to last. Omnia has been known for quality for more than 40 years, so you can be assured that this modern cabinet hardware will endure through the lifetime of your home. Available in either a 3 inch length or a 6 inch length, this pull will match nicely to both contemporary or traditional style homes; and since it is Aluminum (US28) finished, you can be sure that it will look great too.

Omnia's line of sophisticated Aluminum cabinet hardware have been painstakingly crafted by artisans who understand that a beautiful design must be as comfortable to the hand as it is pleasing to the eyes.

  • OMN-AL400/76 - Center to Center Mount Hole Spacing: 3", Overall Length: 4-5/16", Projection: 15/16"
